season_arc.premise: Broke 21-year-old mechanic Ren Tojo hot-wires four dead Vixen Frames mid-duel and wins, so salvage law makes him the legal property and sole co-pilot of disgraced all-women Vixen Flight. Stuck sharing one bunk, one schedule board, and one body, the five must grind from the bottom of the televised ladder back toward ace rank.
season_arc.central_conflict: Four rivalrous adult pilots need Ren's freak 90% sync to win but have to share him by contract, while rival wings file buyouts, wager for his nights, and send seducers to steal him, and his own body burns out from uncalibrated sync.
season_arc.escalation: Premiere establishes the salvage claim and shared bunk comedy, early-mid builds custody fights and poach attempts into rank exhibitions, EP6 burns Ren out on live TV and exposes his implant scar, late arc turns seduction and sponsor pressure into rank-or-lose duels that force Ren to choose who he syncs with.
season_arc.finale_payoff: EP12 resolves the Road Back to Ace qualifier and Ren's contract status with a renegotiated shared deal earned by choice, not law, while the Sync Freak Mystery of who built Ren stays open as a hook.

episodes.title: Hot-Wired Property
episodes.logline: When Vixen Flight's Frames go dead in a televised drop-match against Harrow Wing, pit mechanic Ren Tojo jams a live cable into four locked cockpits in a borrowed plug suit and drags them back to a steal. The league calls it salvage: Ren, his contract, and his bunk now belong to Vixen.
key_beats: Ren hustles in the pits as bottom-ranked Vixen Flight gets flattened by Harrow Wing on broadcast.
Ren grabs a live calibration cable and hot-syncs Mira's dead Frame topless in an oversized borrowed plug suit.
He chains 90%+ syncs across Sable, Juno, and Tessa to steal the duel in one rowdy run.
League officials invoke salvage law and chip Ren's contract to Mira as flight lead.
Vixens drag their new shared property home to one bunk and a blank schedule board.
episodes.cliffhanger: Mira stamps Ren's contract chip on camera: he sleeps in Vixen bunk starting tonight.
episodes.character_arc: Ren goes from invisible pit help to prized property who talks back, and Mira goes from disgraced lead to legal holder of a last chance.

episodes.title: The Custody Whiteboard
episodes.logline: Vixen tries to civilize co-ownership with a shared bunk schedule board for calibration, towel-offs, and sleepovers. Ren negotiates his price per slot, and the board does not survive the first night.
key_beats: Mira posts a strict rotation for who gets Ren for calibration and bunk space.
Sable claims first towel-off after a plug-suit squeeze test in the hangar.
Juno teases Ren into trading slots for favors, sparking a roommate brawl.
Tessa logs Ren's sync spikes and warns hot sync without calibration will burn his nerves.
The board gets wiped and rewritten as a nightly dare instead of a rota.
episodes.cliffhanger: Ren erases his own bedtime and writes in: winner of tomorrow's exhibition picks me.
episodes.character_arc: The four pilots admit they want exclusive time, and Ren learns to play them against each other to get paid and rested.

episodes.title: Sponsor Leash
episodes.logline: With no sponsor money and bottom-tier pit slots, Mira begs their old backer for an exhibition slot. The rep agrees if Vixen pimps Ren out for promos, fittings, and a club appearance.

new_plotline.name: Sponsor Leash
new_plotline.summary: Cash-strapped Vixen must perform sponsor favors and promo appearances to keep pit slots and climb, with Dana Quill holding their leash and eyeing Ren's contract.

key_beats: Mira shows her cracked ace trophy and begs Dana Quill for one more sponsor chance.
Dana demands Ren in promo plug-suit fittings and a rowdy afterparty club spot.
Sable and Juno fight over who escorts Ren while Tessa tailors his borrowed suit.
Ren flips the promo into a bidding joke that packs the club and saves the slot.
Vixen earns a low exhibition bout but now owes Dana ratings.
episodes.cliffhanger: Dana files a formal option on Ren's contract if Vixen misses ratings twice.
episodes.character_arc: Mira swallows pride for her flight, and Ren proves he can sell himself without selling out.

episodes.title: Poach Bait
episodes.logline: Rival scouts flood the pits with buyout slates and a honey-trap pilot invites Ren to a private calibration party. Juno intercepts the radio chatter and decides to honey-trap him first.
key_beats: Rival offer slates for Ren pile up after the Harrow upset airs in replays.
A rival honey-trap pilot corners Ren in the bathhouse with a no-contract offer.
Juno catches it on her scout radio and crashes the seduction with towels and timing.
Sable challenges the rival to a pit brawl over touching shared property.
Ren rejects the buyout but keeps the rival's slate as leverage over Mira.
episodes.cliffhanger: Juno pockets the intercepted frequency: someone is coordinating the poach offers.
episodes.character_arc: Juno shifts from teasing bystander to jealous guard dog, and Ren learns his sync has a street price.

episodes.title: Nerves and Needles
episodes.logline: Tessa pulls Ren into her diagnostic rig for real calibration after his nosebleeds and blackouts. She finds a black-market nape implant scar and a sync curve that should be impossible.
key_beats: Tessa claims Ren's calibration slot to run full nerve diagnostics.
A straddled calibration squeeze spikes past 90% then crashes Ren hard.
Tessa finds the old implant scar on his nape and mismatched surgical records.
Ren admits he bought street repairs after a childhood wreck and never asked questions.
Mira orders the scar kept off broadcast while Tessa keeps a secret sample.
episodes.cliffhanger: Tessa's rig pings an unknown prototype Frame core responding to Ren's signal.
episodes.character_arc: Tessa moves from shy gunner to Ren's protector-tech, and Ren stops joking about the burn for the first time.

episodes.title: Wager Night
episodes.logline: Vixen gets a ladder exhibition against the Cobalt Jackals, who wager sponsor cash against three nights with Ren. Forced to pick one pilot to sync with, Ren burns out on live TV to save the win.
key_beats: The Jackals issue a televised wager contract for Ren's calibration nights.
Custody war peaks as each Vixen argues why Ren should sync with her.
Ren picks Sable for raw power and spikes dangerously high without calibration.
He holds the hot sync too long, wins the bout, then collapses bleeding.
Broadcast zooms on his nape scar as medics cut away his plug suit.
League freezes wagers on Ren pending a health review pushed by Dana.
episodes.cliffhanger: Tessa whispers the rig data to Mira: his signal matched a dead prototype core mid-sync.
episodes.character_arc: Sable learns winning with Ren can hurt him, and Ren learns choosing one means wounding the other three.

episodes.title: Bathhouse Claim
episodes.logline: Under health review and stuck on light duty, Ren gets fought over in towels when the bathhouse becomes the only legal calibration. Dana demands a fan-service apology stream to keep their slot.
key_beats: League bans cockpit sync for a week, so towel-offs become the battleground.
Mira enforces a no-seduction rest order that no one obeys.
Sable, Juno, and Tessa stage escalating bathhouse claims for drying and massage.
Dana forces a rowdy apology broadcast from the bathhouse to save ratings.
Ren turns the stream into a witty auction of his own chores that wins the crowd.
episodes.cliffhanger: Ratings spike, but Dana doubles the sponsor debt: win next bout or lose pit priority.
episodes.character_arc: Mira loosens from warden to teammate, and Ren reclaims agency by monetizing the teasing.

episodes.title: The Surgeon Hunt
episodes.logline: Tessa traces Ren's implant to a street doc and drags Ren and Juno to the neon market afterparties for answers. They learn his co-pilot nerves were rebuilt to be shared.

new_plotline.name: Black-Market Surgeon
new_plotline.summary: Tessa hunts Doc Ilsa Vane through black-market clinics to learn who rebuilt Ren for high sync and why his signal wakes dead cores.

key_beats: Tessa matches Ren's scar to Doc Ilsa Vane's shuttered clinic.
Juno uses poach-bait contacts to get them into a rival afterparty club.
They find Vane's log noting a boy rebuilt with a prototype co-pilot interface.
Ren parties his way out of a rival seduction trap without breaking contract.
Vane vanishes but leaves a dead prototype Frame core addressed to Ren.
episodes.cliffhanger: The gifted core powers for three seconds when Ren touches it.
episodes.character_arc: Ren faces he was made, not born, for this, and Tessa vows to fix what the builder broke.

episodes.title: Iron Lilies
episodes.logline: Vixen risks their new pit priority in a rank grinder against Vex Morra's Iron Lilies, who bring custom anti-sync static and a buyout slate for Ren. Ren must rapid-swap sync between two pilots to break the jam.
key_beats: Iron Lilies challenge with static that caps normal pairs at 20% sync.
Vex offers Ren a clean buyout and a starting bunk if he throws the match.
Mira starts in sync with Ren but gets jammed mid-duel.
Ren hot-swaps to Tessa mid-cockpit with a timed cable pull.
Vixen wins ugly and climbs off the bottom rung of the ladder.
episodes.cliffhanger: League posts the ace qualifier bracket: one win away, but Ren's health flag is still active.
episodes.character_arc: Mira trusts Ren to disobey her mid-duel, and Ren proves sharing sync can be a tactic, not just jealousy.

episodes.title: Honey-Trap Weekend
episodes.logline: Banned from the cockpit before the qualifier, Ren gets loaned to a sponsor retreat crawling with rival honey-trap pilots. Juno goes undercover as his date to run interference.
key_beats: Dana loans Ren to a sponsor weekend as promo punishment.
Rival pilots take turns luring Ren with private calibrations and contract breaks.
Juno poses as his possessive girlfriend to block each attempt.
Her teasing turns sincere when Ren picks her over a clean escape offer.
Juno's radio catches the poach orders coming from inside the sponsor office.
episodes.cliffhanger: Juno plays the intercept for Mira: Dana is shopping Ren's option to rivals.
episodes.character_arc: Juno drops the joke long enough to admit she wants Ren, and Ren chooses Vixen when no one would know.

episodes.title: No-Share Night
episodes.logline: On the eve of the ace qualifier, the schedule board explodes when Mira benches Ren for his own safety. Ren calls a bunk-room negotiation and demands a new price for his body and choice.
key_beats: Mira tries to protect Ren by pulling him from the qualifier lineup.
All four pilots fracture over whether to risk him for ace rank.
Ren calls a lap negotiation and lists every burn, debt, and night owed.
He tears up the old board and demands choice of pilot and cut of winnings.
Mira smashes her cracked ace trophy and agrees to fly on his terms.
episodes.cliffhanger: Ren posts the new board with one name circled for the qualifier — unseen.
episodes.character_arc: Ren stops being property and becomes a partner, and Mira stops commanding and starts trusting.

episodes.title: Shared Property, Shared Win
episodes.logline: Vixen enters the televised ace qualifier against Dagger Wing champions, who wager Ren's full contract option held by Dana. Ren syncs hurt and hot to drag Vixen back toward ace and rewrite the deal.
key_beats: Dagger Wing puts Ren's sponsor option on the table as the official duel wager.
Vixen flies the qualifier with Ren's choice of sync partner revealed live.
Rivals jam sync and target Ren's cockpit to force a burnout.
The flight rapid-shares Ren between Frames for one combined strike.
Vixen wins the qualifier and voids Dana's option, keeping Ren.
Ren signs a new shared contract with pay, veto, and his pick of bunkmates.
episodes.cliffhanger: As they celebrate, the prototype core in Tessa's lab wakes and calls Ren by name.
episodes.character_arc: Vixen re-earns ace contention as a chosen family, and Ren chooses to be shared on his own terms.
